text:
Alex Chen: Deploy request: pushing hotfix image for embeddings-service to staging. Patch fixes rare KV cache eviction that caused 503s in EU1. Requesting expedited approvals for the midnight change window (23:45-00:15 UTC). Revert plan included. @Maya @Jordan @Priya @Lee

deploybot: [deploy-request id=592301] staging requested by Alex Chen. flags: hotfix, expedited. Can skip full canary if ops+qa ok.

Maya: @Alex need one-line release note and rollback triggers. Any customer-facing impact? :thinking:

Alex Chen: Release note: "Fix rare KV cache eviction causing 503s in EU1 embeddings under high load." Non-customer-facing aside from transient 503s. No schema or DB changes. Rollback triggers: >0.5% 5xx for 5m OR p95 latency increase >200ms sustained for 5m. Canary success: no 5xx for 10m.

Jordan: Oncall ack, available to monitor 23:30-01:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Ops question: can we do a staged ramp (25% -> 50% -> 100%) instead of skipping canary? If yes I'll sign off. Confirming no infra changes?

Alex Chen: Confirmed: staged ramp 25% for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then full. No infra changes. Revert command if needed:

```
kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=gcr.io/redwood/embed:v2.3.0 --namespace=staging
```

Lee: Quick smoke on staging build (-hotfix) passed: generate + embed sanity checks and KV stability samples looked good. :white_check_mark:

Maya: @Priya @Jordan @Lee need +1s for expedited so we can hit the window. Please reply within 15m.

Jordan: +1

Priya Nair: +1 for staged 25% canary then ramp. I'll watch infra and be ready to execute revert.

Lee: +1 from QA.

Alex Chen: Thanks — kicking canary in ~10m. Deploybot will post progress updates.

deploybot: [deploy 592301] canary shift to 25% started at 6132468035

Alex Chen: Observing metrics after 5m: no 5xx spikes, p95 stable. Proceeding to 50% in 5m.

deploybot: [deploy 592301] canary shift to 50% started at 6132468055

Maya: Noted. Prep release note draft and i'll post to #release-notes after full ramp.

Alex Chen: Full ramp complete at 6132468065. Health checks green, closing hotfix.

Maya: Marking as expedited hotfix and adding to release tracker. Thanks team — if this recurs please open a postmortem.

Jordan: Standing by for another 30m then handoff to next oncall. Good job everyone.
